title: Test games in web browsers and phones
touches: Nothing: you try games and report what you find
summary: Aven games can run in web browsers. Try the templates on the browsers and phones you have and tell us what works.
why: We can't own every phone and browser. Your testing tells us what to fix.

steps.text: Open a template game, then Build & Share > Web browser > Build for the web.
Build & Share > Share > Start sharing, then open the link (or scan the game card) on a phone or another computer on the same Wi-Fi.
Play for a minute. Does it look right? Do the controls work? Is there sound after you press Play? (On phones, taps work like mouse clicks; games that need a keyboard can't be played there yet.)
Write down the device, browser and what you saw, and post it in a GitHub issue titled 'Web test: <template> on <device>'.

submit: A GitHub issue with your results. Screenshots help a lot.
